subject: lavaan 0.6-2 has been released on CRAN

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: lavaan 0.6-2 has been released on CRAN
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

lavaan 0.6-2 has arrived at CRAN. To install, simply to in R:

install.packages("lavaan", dependencies = TRUE)

and restart your R session.

The release notes can be found here: http://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot6.html

Yves.
